construction: Ornn says OCPI uses anonymized executed on-demand GPU rentals from a global provider network, USD-equivalent/GPU-hour; reserved/long-term/forward contracts excluded. By GPU type, it computes a volume-weighted mean of winsorized realized prices over rolling one-hour windows. Verified counterparties/hardware and provider reliability/latency filters apply; no minimum rental size. Providers, counts, regional composition, weights and per-point quality flags are not exposed in free API.
publication_and_unit: Official dashboard docs (capture logs/deep_review_20261017/case0374_method_1800/dashboard_docs.body.json.gz; 2026-10-19 17:55:54Z; raw SHA 5bbd2e7ecfafd5f71371e995f62a845790a72c3b9a0e6ceb56f9e3f3628be591, gzip SHA 19bfd58b54b5fa37b678664880cfb36fd2e2ceec9294e6aadb64137e2a59196d) define hourly current index vs settled daily close/history. Methodology says hourly close values publish promptly to $0.001. Existing series work/0374_facts_1647.json is trailing 3mo only; public docs say earlier startDate is clamped. API numeric `index_value` is an index, not itself a single trade quote.
revision_and_finality: Methodology generally does not restate history, except suspected provider falsification or material calculation error; it allows dated methodology changes. Risk disclosure as of 2026-06-18 (logs/deep_review_20261017/case0374_method_1800/risk_disclosure.body.json.gz; raw SHA 389857774a4e1ddb2d0ba02ff2ae36e20fa3ba2342702640cc07b10d914063f6; gzip SHA f118970b81b752dff4efbad11ee78bd155e950f51b2a4f954565e12a41d6e5cc) warns low coverage/liquidity/data-quality/operations may make values indicative, delayed or unavailable. Neither source exposes per-point status. Frozen contract finalizes a daily value upon next-day point and ignores later revisions, which may diverge from administrator correction policy.
